region: Salmon River–Mira River, Huntington and Grand Mira
findings: Terrain exaggeration makes the ridges beside the Mira corridor clearer. Toggling the sheet exposes the modern river and surrounding valleys.

The engraved main river generally follows the same broad corridor, but individual bank shapes and adjoining water features remain displaced. This is visual diagnostic context, not a numerical accuracy assessment.
The source and modern Salmon mouth have different detailed shore forms. No point was measured from the oblique scene.
